Production adaptation: The text above defines the visual idea and action. For this call output only ONE PNG SPRITE SHEET, NOT a GIF file: exactly 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 equal square cells, chronological row-major order. Keep scale, character identity, palette and geometry consistent; each cell is one distinctly different consecutive animation pose with nothing crossing cell boundaries. Cells will be extracted and encoded locally afterward. Make the motion return naturally from the final cell to the first.
Exactly twelve distinct chronological poses: staff rotates in the hand through a full turn over frames 1–8, sparkles appear at 9–10, fade at 11, ready pose at 12. No timecodes, no numbers, no written text.
